description: June was a very busy month! While I didn't have a primary election, there wasn't much time to slow down. Now that the primaries are behind us, we know what's ahead in the general election, and the real work begins. Outside of the Legislature, I stayed busy in my work as a physician and professor, teaching the next generation of healthcare providers. Summer is one of the toughest times of the year for those experiencing homelessness, and our team continued providing care to men, women, and children across the valley. By bringing healthcare directly to people in need, we can often prevent unnecessary emergency room visits. I had the opportunity to visit The Courtyard, SHARE Village, the Catholic Worker, and several other community locations. June 20 was also World Refugee Day, and it was a privilege to provide care to many members of our immigrant communities. I always enjoy practicing my Spanish and connecting with patients from many different backgrounds.
title: Assembly District 35 July Newsletter!
